preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N (number of nodes minus 1) is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= M <= 10**5 for N, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, M (number of edges) is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x_i <= N and 0 <= y_i <= N for test_case in test_cases for x_i, y_i in test_case.edges)
preconditions.description: For each edge in every test case, x_i and y_i are between 0 and N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_sequence) == N or output_sequence == [-1] for output_sequence in outputs)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either a sequence of N positive integers or -1.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= a <= 10**9 for a in output_sequence) if output_sequence != [-1] else True for output_sequence in outputs)
postconditions.description: If the output is a sequence, all its elements are positive integers.

postconditions.expression: all(output_sequence == [-1] or (output_sequence == lex_smallest_sequence and is_valid_sequence(output_sequence, edges)) for output_sequence, edges in zip(outputs, test_cases_edges))
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, it is the lexicographically smallest sequence that can generate the given graph edges, or -1 if no such sequence exists.
